rows.label: Antivirus mods
rows.alt: buy the stragglers from other players

conditions: Four depleted mods of one type transmute into one fresh charged mod of that type.
bonuses: Antivirus and Potency mods drop as public loot off any squadmate's stab, so pubbing tops you up even when your own Coda hasn't spawned.

rows.label: correct Antivirus mercy
rows.note: all 3 equipped mods tested at once; no penalty for a wrong guess

rows.label: 100% disinfection
rows.note: 2 Potency mods once the Antivirus is known; missions alone cap at 95%

conditions: Duets spawn at 25% per mission, +25% per miss, guaranteed on the 4th; the usual timing is 3-5 minutes in.
A Duet that stumbles 3 times unstabbed, or a downed squad, flees the encounter.
A stab gives 5% plus 10% or 15% per equipped Potency mod (35% max); size your Potency mods to land on or past 100% rather than getting stuck just under it.
Phases 1 and 3 are hazard-dodging with Transference disabled; phases 2 and 4 are the real fight, and the frontman regenerates until his backup band is dead.
DJ RoM hits with heavy Toxin that bypasses shield gating; kill him first among the Duets.
Bring overguard or invulnerability (Revenant's Mesmer Skin, Nyx's Absorb, Valkyr, Dante); stage hazards don't consume Mesmer Skin charges.
bonuses: Leave the mission right after a correct-Antivirus stab; the 5% and any Potency bonus bank immediately, even on abort.
Duets spawn during bounties too, so running the Antivirus Bounty stacks Hex standing, Antivirus mods and disinfection progress at once.
Doing the Concert in a public squad pays +1 Heartcell for every extra Coda a squadmate vanquishes, up to +3 in a full squad.

groups.meta: Batch B, one copy per 4-day rotation
conditions: Synapse is Batch B, alongside Bassocyst, Bubonico, Tysis, Caustacyst, Hirudo and Pathocyst; Batch A carries no Synapse.
One purchase per weapon per rotation; rotations flip every 4 days.
An empty weapon slot is required before Eleanor will sell to you.
bonuses: Watch Eleanor's rotation for a strong roll before farming extras; 55-60% Synapse rolls get posted often enough that waiting a rotation or two is reasonable.

conditions: Fusion takes the higher of the two bonuses x 1.1, capped at 60%.
Fuse into the copy holding your Forma and Catalyst; the donor's investments are destroyed.

disclosures.title: a marginal upgrade to some
disclosures.body: The launch feedback thread called the Coda weapons marginal upgrades with no new gimmick, and Synapse's riven disposition (0.90x) sits below the base Synapse's (1.31x). Fans still like its 40% crit and high DPS. Take the first usable roll rather than grinding for 60% unless you're already sold on the weapon.
